summary: On an internet-connected RHEL host, enable `rhel-9-for-x86_64-baseos-rpms` and `rhel-9-for-x86_64-appstream-rpms`, install `yum-utils`, run `reposync -m --download-metadata --gpgcheck -p /path/to/download` (without `--newest-only`), then move the repos into the disconnected network.
questions: How do I reposync RHEL repos for an offline AAP install?
reposync command for BaseOS and AppStream

answer_card.title: Sync RHEL repos with reposync
answer_card.answer_md:
On a connected RHEL 9 host:
```bash
subscription-manager repos \
  --enable rhel-9-for-x86_64-baseos-rpms \
  --enable rhel-9-for-x86_64-appstream-rpms
dnf install yum-utils
reposync -m --download-metadata --gpgcheck -p /path/to/download
```
Then copy the repos into the disconnected network and serve them from a web server.
